I am an old woman here in Kigoma, 72 years now, and my strength is not what it used to be. This small plot I work together with my grandchildren, and we plant together with other crops mixed in as we have always done. I have no money for the shop fertilizers or the new seeds from town — I use the seeds I saved from last harvest and the manure from the few goats we keep. The rains will water the plot as God provides; I cannot carry water to it.
